items.title: Nvidia's $130 Billion Forecast Sparks Fresh AI Stock Rally
items.summary: Nvidia's third-quarter revenue more than doubled to $115.84 billion, marking its 17th consecutive earnings estimate beat.

items.title: Target shares rise 7% as retailer posts best sales growth in five years, hikes guidance
items.summary: Target beat third-quarter sales expectations and raised its guidance as it continues a turnaround effort.

items.title: Half of David Jones job cuts are casual staff with no entitlements
items.summary: More than 1,500 jobs are going, and many of them are casuals with no entitlements, as the retailer's receiver closes half the department store's network.

aus.headline: David Jones To Shed 1,500 Jobs
aus.body: Receivers are closing half of David Jones' stores; many lost jobs belong to casuals.
aus.why: Many of the affected workers leave without entitlements.

us.headline: Nvidia Sales More Than Double
us.body: Nvidia's third-quarter revenue reached $115.84 billion, its 17th straight estimate beat.
us.why: The result sparked a fresh rally across AI stocks.

biz.headline: Target Shares Jump 7%
biz.body: The retailer topped what analysts expected for quarterly sales and raised its outlook.
biz.why: Sales are rising at the chain's fastest pace in half a decade.
